generation.scope: All remaining nodal and cuspidal integral eight-cofactor opposite matrices have an explicit quartic pencil, including the compactified boundary Hankel determinant. The quadratic principal entry at the singular kernel point factors into two linear forms and is a square at a nodal order-two member or the cuspidal boundary. Every finite unbranched member has the displayed binary Bezout normal form; the general transform in each type is excluded by nineteen quartic minors.
